stage_b_reviewed_content.statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, let $\Lambda$ be a torsion ring, and $K\in D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)$. Let $Rf^!$ be the right adjoint to the compactification-defined lower shriek $Rf_!$. For any affine étale $U\to X$, form the separated finite-type structural morphism $g_U:U\to Y$, and let $U\mapsto R(g_U)_!\underline\Lambda$ be the contravariant derived functor on the affine étale site induced by the counits of étale extension by zero. For each integer $n$, the restriction of the cohomology sheaf $H^n(Rf^!K)$ to $X_{affine,\acute et}$ is the sheafification of the presheaf $$U\longmapsto \operatorname{Hom}_{D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)}(R(g_U)_!\underline\Lambda,K[n]).$$
